scope: Data sources used by the manuscript; native source records remain authoritative. URLs are provider catalog/resource locations retained in acquisition code and manifests. Catalog presence does not certify historical archive permanence.

sources.name: PLATEAU CityGML
sources.role: Buildings, terrain gap filling, surface roads and water polygons

sources.name: Tokyo wards airborne laser survey
sources.role: Primary bare-earth terrain; point-cloud and orthophoto context checks
sources.access: Provider download; catalog release year is not a certification of every survey epoch

sources.name: JMA composite radar archived by Kyoto University RISH
sources.version: Parameter 203; original GRIB2; 2024 and 2025 event windows
sources.role: Historical rainfall forcing, including the separate geometry-reference parent
sources.access: RISH archive use conditions; JMA producer attribution

sources.name: 2020 Population Census, e-Stat
sources.role: Official basic-unit nighttime population baseline; 125/250 m mesh allocation checks
sources.access: Public statistical aggregates; population stocks are not observed event-time travelers

sources.name: OpenStreetMap via Geofabrik
sources.role: Directed surface road network and tagged structures/access restrictions
sources.access: ODbL; retain OpenStreetMap contributor attribution; dated extracts may expire

sources.name: MLIT National Land Numerical Information
sources.version: N03 2024 administrative boundaries; W05 2008 Tokyo river lines
sources.role: Regional context and river/waterbody matching; not surveyed river bathymetry

sources.name: MLIT National Road and Street Traffic Conditions Survey
sources.role: Normal-road traffic observations and section/geometry constraints
sources.access: Public survey tables; observation/estimation flags retained

sources.name: Tokyo Metropolitan Area Person Trip Survey
sources.role: OD and temporal constraints for scenario vehicle demand
sources.access: Download/application and provider conditions apply; personal sessions are not distributed

sources.name: Geospatial Information Authority of Japan tiles
sources.version: Retained tiles at acquisition; not a replacement for the native Tokyo DEM
sources.access: GSI source conditions; templates use slippy-map tile indices
